runtime_source_semantics.raw_outer_attitude_semantics: The locked runtime sets raw=target and logs raw_outer_attitude from rawAtt; filtered_attitude_reference is logged from ir.euler returned by command_filter_step at the same event step.

physical_contract.d_definition: d=a_actual-a_f; a_actual=R(actual Euler)e3*T_real/m + wind_force_I/m - g*e3; a_f=R(filtered attitude)e3*T_req/m - g*e3.

terms_mps2.logged_wind_force_I_over_mass: wind_force_I/m as logged; this is not separately asserted to be ambient wind only

scope.groups: ALL=12; HF_W09_W14=6 using W09_W11 or W12_W14; W15=3.
scope.rms_definition: ALL=sqrt(mean_time(sum_xyz(component^2))) is vector-norm RMS; X/Y/Z are component RMS. Group values are equal-scene arithmetic means of per-run RMS. These ALL values are sqrt(3) larger than an elementwise component RMSE for isotropic errors and must not be mixed with it.
scope.aggregation: For each run compute temporal RMS first; group values are equal-scene arithmetic means of those per-run RMS values. RMS components are not additive percentages.

frequency_method.boundary_bins: 1500 samples at 100 Hz use exact bin indices: 0..14, 15..74, 75..750; Nyquist bin 750 is included.
frequency_method.method: One-sided rFFT Parseval weights; each run/window transformed independently, no concatenated trajectories, detrending or lag search. Each run stores per-axis Parseval and band-power closure errors (<1e-12).

limits: The 12 records are the original ON1 closed-loop states. This decomposes observed same-state forces, not counterfactual controller effects or a new rollout.
The logged wind_force_I vector is used only as an offline force term; its nonzero value is not asserted to mean nonzero ambient wind, and it is not a deployment input.
Frequency bands describe the logged 5-20 s error on the fixed 100-Hz event grid; no causal interpretation or tuning is implied.
All raw/config/source path hashes and raw stat/hash before-after checks are retained.
Plant=0 new, training=0, optimizer=0, GPU=0, TEST=false.
